subject: ENGL
title: English Composition I
description: A composition course focusing on skills required for effective writing in a variety of contexts, with emphasis on exposition, analysis, and argumentation, and also including introductory use of a variety of research skills. Develops analytical reading and writing skills through the investigation of methods used in cultural and literary studies and the application of those methods to specific texts.
notes: Sheet: 'ENGL 1101 Engl Comp I'.

subject: MATH

plan: General 8 Semester Plan, No Threads, AY 2025-26 (College of Computing credit sheet)

plan: General 8 Semester Plan, No Threads, AY 2025-26 (College of Computing credit sheet)
